sloka: कूटैश्च बहुधाकीर्णैः शोभितं बहुकन्दरैः ।सालतालाश्वकर्णैश्च वंशैश्च बहुभिर्वृतम् ।। 5.56.17 ।।।।
transliteration: kūṭaiśca bahudhākīrṇaiḥ śobhitaṁ bahukandaraiḥ ।sālatālāśvakarṇaiśca vaṁśaiśca bahubhirvṛtam ।। 5.56.17 ।।।।

translations.english: With many kinds of caves and peaks scattered all over, the mountain looked delightful. It was canopied with numerous trees like Sal, palms, Aswakarnas and bamboos.
